Welcome to the Northfield Amateur Astronomers!

We are a small club of backyard stargazers who meet on the first Friday of every month at the old observatory on Hill Road. Beginners are always welcome, and you do not need your own telescope to join us.

Our 10" Dobsonian is available to members on clear nights.

Bring warm clothes & a red flashlight!
